summary: Grande Group Limited, a Hong Kong-listed finance services foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing that CFO Ka Yan Ying resigned effective October 29, 2026, citing personal reasons and no disagreement with the company, and that the board appointed Ching Man Tam, age 34, as CFO effective October 30, 2026. Tam's initial one-year term auto-renews absent three months' notice; annual compensation is HK$120,000 (about US$15,300), paid monthly. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the appointment appears. The abrupt CFO turnover is the event; watch for follow-on disclosure on financial controls, reporting timing, or further executive attrition.
